title: spec: an agent's model.provider is declared but read by no runtime (enforce-or-remove)
body:
epic:#5055#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMmczBEaeiAQ48oDtz

Filing gate: ① declared ≠ enforced (ADR-0049 enforce-or-remove) · Source: contract review of objectstack-ai/objectstack#37697 (comment 7204641048, S1) and the dev's acceptance note on objectstack-ai/objectstack#37686.
Grade: to be graded · area:ai · finding · evidence: read (objectstack main; objectstack-ai/cloud main `packages/service-ai/src/agent-runtime.ts`)
Reader: triage / spec lane.
Dedupe: open issues naming `model.provider` on agents → none found.

## 维护者速读
- 是什么：agent 元数据里的 `model.provider`（openai / azure_openai / anthropic / local）没有任何运行时读取，写了也不起作用，只在预览里显示一个标签。按“执行或移除”规则该退役或接上。
- 影响：AI 写 agent 时可能以为能指定供应商；实际由部署配置决定。
- 要你做什么：无（分诊定级）。

## Evidence
- `packages/spec/src/ai/agent.zod.ts` `AIModelConfigSchema.provider` (enum, default `'openai'` on main).
- No reader of an agent's `model.provider` in objectstack runtime code; in objectstack-ai/cloud `agent-runtime.ts` reads only `model`, `temperature`, `maxTokens` from the agent block.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/AgentPreview.tsx` shows it as a pill.

## Direction (for triage)
Retire per ADR-0049 (the provider is the deployment's choice; phase 1 of objectstack-ai/cloud#5055 resolves models by id across configured providers), using the `spec-property-retirement` playbook — or enforce it if a consumer needs it. Not part of #37697 (which only drops its default).
